name: POST /api/leadflow/offers/feature-matrix - set one capability status
description:
Sets or updates one capability's status, and REFUSES an entry with no named owner (92ce5959-0e5c-4ce8-be7a-02cc870b2120#AC3). The refusal is the point: a capability claim with no owner is one nobody is accountable for, and the moment somebody disputes what was promised there is no one to ask.

THE STATUS MUST BE ONE OF THE FIVE APPROVED LABELS. Anything else is a claim nobody reviewed, so it is refused at the boundary rather than stored and discovered later on a buyer's call.

UPSERT ON (tenant, offer, capability), refreshing updated_at. One row per capability rather than an append-only log, because the question a rep asks is "what may I say about this today" and two rows cannot answer it without a rule about which one wins. QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: A capability is recorded with its status and named owner

testCases.name: NEGATIVE: a status outside the five approved labels
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: status must be one of LIVE, BETA, ROADMAP, USAGE_THIRD_PARTY, NOT_INCLUDED
errorCases.when: offer_key or capability is missing, the status is outside the five approved labels, or no owner_user_id can be determined - a capability claim nobody owns is one nobody is accountable for.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
